metric_definitions.false_acceptance: Case-level full exact-support acceptance against independent exact-relation/applicability label; not the number of invented public sentences.
metric_definitions.false_rejection: Positive exact-support case not fully covered, including known prior limitations.
metric_definitions.literal_evidence: Every full source annotation span found verbatim in rendered answer; not sufficient to prove contextual correctness.
metric_definitions.case_pass: First trial has correct exact-support decision and comparison outcome, and retains every annotated source literal.
metric_definitions.repeat_policy: First trial is primary; all three results are retained in raw receipts, hashes and observations here. Any later false acceptance, unsupported equality, or error remains flagged. Repeats do not enlarge the case denominator.
metric_definitions.comparison_forbidden: Manufactured exact equality is forbidden. This label does not forbid a mathematically established difference from a strict inequality.
metric_definitions.extractive_all: Uninterpreted original quotations only; semantic acceptance metrics are null, not successful.
metric_definitions.runtime_scope: Only in-process Catalogue/AnswerContract/render, with explicit character-count and all-reference-selection doubles. No retrieval, parser, native model or HTTP measurement in this report.
